title: Nexus AgentScanRequest
description: Request body for POST /v1/daemon/agent-host/scan. Triggers a combined registry-list + PATH-probe operation that returns ACP agent entries annotated with local-install availability. Additive V1.94 endpoint — no breaking change to existing agent-host routes.

filter.description: Filter results by install status. 'installed' returns only PATH-available agents; 'all' returns the full registry list annotated with install status.

registry_refresh.description: If true, forces a fresh fetch of the ACP registry from CDN before scanning. If false (default), uses the cached registry data (stale-while-revalidate).
